main.title: Summary
text: QA lead with 9 years in e-commerce and logistics. I build quality cultures: shift-left testing, contract testing between microservices and reliable automation that teams trust.

items.heading: QA Automation Lead — Example Logistics
bullets: Lead a team of 6 QA engineers across 4 product squads.
Introduced consumer-driven contract tests with Pact for 20 microservices.
Built performance test suites with Gatling for peak season.
Reduced flaky tests from 12% to under 1%.

items.heading: Senior QA Engineer — Sample E-commerce
bullets: Created a Selenium + Java framework and integrated it into Azure DevOps pipelines.
Tested Kafka-based order events and database consistency.
